text: さいこうの　きょういくを　うけて　ここまで　つよく　なったわ！

structure.jp: さいこうの　きょういくを　うけて
structure.en: I received the best education, and

structure.jp: ここまで　つよく　なったわ！

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: A describing word with い changed to く plus なる means 'become'. つよく　なった = 'became strong'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next, like 'and', here also hinting at the reason. きょういくを　うけて = 'I got an education and so'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end gives a feminine firmness to what the speaker says. つよく　なったわ = 'I became strong!'.
